title: Farm, hunt, and defend
hook: **Farm / hunt / defend** names the territorial loop — yield and materials, prey and capture, Seat and homeworld — so it cannot hide under “the rift.”

blindSpots.meaning: Hold ground, take sector yield, expedition mats, later buildings. [Loam](loam) is position, not a wallet.
Prey on the lawn, wild joins, roaming, delves, map fights — pressure that grows the roster and clears threats.
Fracture and neglect, Seat siege, homeworld as the spine you must not lose.
The verbs are real in this build (loam pressure, fog, claim), but full ecology, buildings, and sieges deepen later.

alsoTrue: Sieges and richer ecology are Vision. Sector buildings and wardens are WIP.
Failure branches and enemy counter-development hang on this loop as Vision — consequence and pushback, not only a wipe.

sections.title: What it is
paras: Three verbs for empire play on and around the rift.
They share stocks and stages: farm leans loam and holdings; hunt leans lawn, capture, delves; defend leans Fracture, Seat, and homeworld.

rows: Hold ground, sector yield, expedition mats, later buildings
Lawn prey, capture, wild joins, roaming, delves, map fights
Fracture and neglect, Seat siege, homeworld spine

groups.title: Across places
groups.intro: There is no single “farm mode” button — the verbs describe how you play.
steps: On the world map: claim and hold for farm; watch loam fade for defend.
On the lawn and expeditions: hunt for prey, materials, and joins.
Treat homeworld safety as defend even while you expand.
groups.note: Status is Shipped (thin) — expect the shape, not the finished ecology.

doSteps: Claim or hold a sector and notice loam pressure (farm / defend).
Play a lawn match or collect an expedition for hunt materials or joins.
Say out loud which verb you are doing — if you cannot, you are probably only marching.
doNote: Stop when “the rift” unpacks into three verbs. Related: [loam](loam), [siege](siege).

mixUps.a: No. Farm uses loam and materials — never a new wallet.
No. Lawn, capture, wild joins, and map prey count. Delves are Vision depth.
No. Neglect and the Fracture are defend — ground can fail without a fight.
It is Shipped thin. Buildings, sieges, and richer ecology are still ahead.
